base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a gleaming high-tech garage bay at the base of the lighthouse, tool walls, hoses, polishing cloths, a circular launch hatch in the floor. Lighting: cool workshop spotlights with copper reflections.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; a gleaming, garden-shed-sized, pressurised transparent bubble with a faint pink rose-tinted shimmer and drifting rose petals inside, strapped to the Tomkin-Mobile's roof rack.
Camera: Two-shot, Tomkin pointing up at the roof.
Action: Tomkin points up at the roof rack where a giant rose-tinted bubble inflates; Duggie's tail goes into overdrive.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, brisk, grudging) says: "You're going on the roof rack. In a pressurised, rose-scented bubble. Rated for re-entry." Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, FAST mode) says: "I LOVE BUBBLES BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!"
Sound effects: bubble inflating, ecstatic tail thwacks, ambience of echoing garage, the hum of machinery.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
